subject.title: Slack: support assistant.threads.setSuggestedPrompts for dynamic prompt suggestions

question: Should configurable and dynamic Slack suggested prompts become a Slack-native OpenClaw config/action surface, or should dynamic suggestions stay in plugin/portable Smart Replies behavior outside this issue?
rationale: Current main has the Slack API primitive and fixed defaults, but the remaining request changes public config and agent-facing action contracts; automation cannot choose that product boundary safely.

options.title: Design the API first
options.body: Keep this issue open while a Slack/plugin owner chooses between Slack-specific config/action support and a portable plugin-facing prompt/presentation contract.

options.title: Implement Slack-native prompts
options.body: Add a bounded Slack plugin config and dynamic action path with schema, docs, focused tests, and live Slack proof.

options.title: Keep plugin-only dynamic suggestions
options.body: Document that OpenClaw core only seeds fixed Slack assistant prompts and route dynamic suggestions through ClawHub or Smart Replies-style plugins.

recommendation.title: Design the API first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while a Slack/plugin owner chooses between Slack-specific config/action support and a portable plugin-facing prompt/presentation contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the current Slack assistant lifecycle implementation and is the strongest history-backed owner for accepting or rejecting the Slack prompt API boundary.
